runs.text: Criticism, or asking if Israel should exist? Here's the difference, in eleven words. A group chat. Someone writes: Israel shouldn't exist. Then adds: relax, it's just criticism. Criticise any government you like. Nobody asks if France should exist. The International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance agrees: criticising Israel like any other country is not antisemitic. But denying the Jewish people the right to self-determination is. And Israelis criticise their own government all the time. In twenty twenty three, they protested it week after week. Save this. Criticise governments. Don't erase countries. Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments. Criticism, or erasing a country? Now you can say the difference.
